message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. The test uses Mockito, but we can avoid needing Mockito by removing those imports and annotations. Instead we can just instantiate objects directly; the @Mock fields are not needed. So we can delete @Mock and related fields, and adjust code to use real stubs.

Also errors about constructors: ValidationContext has no zero-arg constructor; we need to call appropriate super constructor. But we can avoid extending ValidationContext; maybe we can use a concrete implementation provided by library? However we can also create a stub that extends ValidationContext and calls appropriate super constructor. Need to look at ValidationContext constructors signature: from error: ValidationContext.ValidationContext(JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig) and another with more args. So we need to call super(meta, null?, cfg) maybe. We need JsonSchemaFactory class. Could use null for factory? Might be okay. Or we can use a real JsonSchemaFactory from library. Simpler: use JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance()? But we need to pass a JsonSchemaFactory instance. Let's create stub constructor:

StubValidationContext(SchemaValidatorsConfig cfg, JsonMetaSchema meta) {
   super(meta, null, cfg);
   this.cfg = cfg;
   this.meta = meta;
}

But need import JsonSchemaFactory. Provide null for factory; hope not used. Also need to implement abstract methods? ValidationContext may be abstract. It already had abstract methods we overrode. So we need to import JsonSchemaFactory.

Next, StubJsonMetaSchema extends JsonMetaSchema, which has a complex constructor requiring many args. Instead of extending, we can use an existing instance via JsonMetaSchema.getInstance? There may be a static method. Not sure. Could create a stub subclass with a constructor that calls super with dummy values. Need to see JsonMetaSchema constructors: from error: required: String,String,Map<String,Keyword>,Map<String,Boolean>,VersionFlag,Builder. That's many parameters. Hard to construct manually.

Alternative: we can avoid needing JsonMetaSchema at all by using a real instance from library: JsonMetaSchema.getInstance(VersionFlag.V201909) maybe. But we need import VersionFlag. Use JsonMetaSchema.getInstance(VersionFlag.V201909). That returns a JsonMetaSchema. So we don't need StubJsonMetaSchema.

Similarly, SchemaLocation constructor requires AbsoluteIri and JsonNodePath. Could use a real instance: new SchemaLocation(AbsoluteIri.of("http://example.com/schema"), new JsonNodePath(...)). But we can also avoid needing it: maybe JsonSchema.from can accept null for schemaLocation? In setup they pass schemaLocation variable. Could pass null? The method signature: from(ValidationContext, SchemaLocation, JsonNodePath, ObjectNode, JsonSchema, boolean). Might accept null for schemaLocation. In test they only need execution context creation. So we could set schemaLocation = null and evaluationPath = null. That would simplify.

Thus modify setupBeforeEach: set schemaLocation = null; evaluationPath = null; Use real metaSchema from JsonMetaSchema.getInstance.

Remove stub classes for SchemaLocation and JsonNodePath.

Also remove imports for Mockito.

Update fields: remove @Mock annotations and related fields.

The tests that previously used those fields (validationContext, metaSchema, schemaLocation, evaluationPath) will be set in setup.

Also test for null ValidationContext uses reflection to set BaseJsonValidator.validationContext field; that's fine.

Test for null config: they create new StubValidationContext(null, metaSchema). That will call super with null config; okay.

Need to adjust StubValidationContext constructor to call super(meta, null, cfg). But when cfg is null, super expects non-null maybe; but test expects NPE later when calling createExecutionContext, so okay.

Implement getSchemaResources etc.

Now adjust imports: remove Mockito imports, keep JUnit imports, java.util.*, java.lang.reflect.Field, com.fasterxml.jackson.*, maybe need JsonSchemaFactory, VersionFlag.

Add import com.networknt.schema.JsonMetaSchema; import com.networknt.schema.VersionFlag; import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaFactory; import com.networknt.schema.SchemaLocation; import com.networknt.schema.JsonNodePath; import com.networknt.schema.ValidationContext; import com.networknt.schema.SchemaValidatorsConfig; import com.networknt.schema.ExecutionContext; import com.networknt.schema.ExecutionConfig; import com.networknt.schema.ExecutionContextCustomizer; import com.networknt.schema.BaseJsonValidator;

Also need import java.util.Map; maybe not.

Now adjust code.

Let's craft final corrected test class.
